overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1174 concerns monochromatic cliques from edge colorings. This problem remains OPEN.

Known results include: - This is a problem of Erdős and Hajnal - Shelah showed that a graph possessing either property can consistently exist - The problem asks whether such graphs exist in ZFC outright - We restrict the host graph (no K₄, or no K_{ℵ₁})

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1174.
